title: Kestrel Closed-End Consumer Lease Early Termination, Pull-Ahead and Recovery Schedule
content:
**Kestrel Closed-End Consumer Lease — early termination and recovery figures by tier**

| Tier | Early termination fee | Payments made before an early turn-in is accepted | Most remaining payments a pull-ahead may waive |
|---|---|---|---|
| Kestrel Lease Tier 5 | $595 | 3 | 0 (no pull-ahead) |
| Kestrel Lease Tier 4 | $595 | 3 | 0 (no pull-ahead) |
| Kestrel Lease Tier 3 | $495 | 3 | 2 |
| Kestrel Lease Tier 2 | $495 | 3 | 3 |
| Kestrel Lease Tier 1 | $395 | 3 | 3 |
| Kestrel Lease Tier 1+ | $395 | 3 | 4 |

| Tier | Days past due before assignment for repossession, at least | Reinstatement window, calendar days after repossession | Reinstatements over the life of the lease, at most | Involuntary repossession agency fee | Storage charge per day |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Kestrel Lease Tier 5 | 60 | 10 | 1 | $425 | $20 |
| Kestrel Lease Tier 4 | 60 | 10 | 1 | $425 | $20 |
| Kestrel Lease Tier 3 | 75 | 15 | 1 | $425 | $20 |
| Kestrel Lease Tier 2 | 75 | 15 | 1 | $425 | $20 |
| Kestrel Lease Tier 1 | 90 | 21 | 2 | $425 | $20 |
| Kestrel Lease Tier 1+ | 90 | 21 | 2 | $425 | $20 |

**Reading the schedule**

- The early termination fee applies to a turn-in before the scheduled window.
- A tier whose pull-ahead figure is 0 has no pull-ahead.
- Hypothetical illustration: a Kestrel Lease Tier 3 lease with 2 payments remaining is within that tier's pull-ahead figure; with 3 remaining it is not.
